import json

def candidate(top_colors):
    H,W=28,19; a=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    shapes={
      3:[(4,0),(4,1),(5,1),(6,1),(7,1)],
      6:[(5,8)]+[(r,c) for r in (6,7,8) for c in (5,6,7)]+[(9,4)],
      4:[(11,c) for c in range(11,16)]+[(12,13),(13,13)],
      7:[(17,4),(18,4)]+[(19,c) for c in range(2,5)]+[(20,4),(21,4)]}
    for color,pts in shapes.items():
      mn=min(r for r,c in pts); mx=max(r for r,c in pts)
      dr= -mn if color in top_colors else 27-mx
      for r,c in pts: a[r+dr][c]=color
    return a
print(json.dumps(candidate({4,6})))
